description: Land Acquisition - Pepiliyana, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of a servitude (right of way) and land for a public purpose (developing a canal as part of a storm water drainage project). It contains detailed descriptions of the specific land parcels, boundaries, and property details. The content is primarily concerned with land acquisition and property matters, fitting squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). While it mentions a government minister, this is incidental to the land acquisition notice itself and does not involve government structural changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government-related classification.
